pr_title: Check exception causes for matching strings during recorder migration
pr_body:
## Proposed change
<!--
  Describe the big picture of your changes here to communicate to the
  maintainers why we should accept this pull request. If it fixes a bug
  or resolves a feature request, be sure to link to that issue in the
  additional information section.
-->
Check exception causes for matching strings during recorder migration

- sqlalchemy does not pass the string for the mssql dialect so we need to check the cause as well.

- Ideally we would not need to do string matching, but we don't know all the error codes for every dialect and sqlalchemy does not abstract these

issue_context.title: Unable to update from 2021.1.5 due to problems with sqlalchemy (MSSQL)
issue_context.body:
### The problem

When trying to update from docker image homeassistant/home-assistant:2021.1.5  to homeassistant/home-assistant:2021.4.6, home assistant fails **hard**.

My setup consist of a Microsoft SQL Server Developer (64-bit) 15.0.4123.1 running in [Docker ](https://hub.docker.com/_/microsoft-mssql-server)- and the problem has been consistent at least from version 2021.2.3.

Thanks in advance for looking into this; it is frustrating not to keep my HA up-2-date :-)

### What is version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

2021.4.6

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

2021.1.5

### What type of installation are you running?

Home Assistant Container

### Integration causing the issue

recorder
logbook
history
default_config

https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/logbook/
https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/history/
https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/default_config/
